answer: Trust should grow like a grove. We require cross-chain footprint triangulation: one key must show activity on three independent chains over 90 days - a swap on one, a governance vote on a second, a storage deal on a third. A checker verifies the footprints share one key and rejects bulk-bought histories, since bought records cluster like a copied sonnet. Ninety clean days earn full standing; fraud voids all three chains at once. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 30,000 real transactions, $180,000 in fees, and 900,000 days of waiting - a whisper of profit against a mountain of work. - Jowy
